name: envoi-public-read-api
description: Hand-written description of Envoi's two public read routes: the list of published shops and one shop's published menu. Envoi is a test environment: shops marked isDemoFixture are seeded demo fixtures, and payments use PayPal sandbox test money only. Nothing in this API pays, approves or prices a purchase; a buyer's price is always recalculated by Envoi at review. Prices are whole Singapore cents, and an unknown price or availability is null, never zero or false. This file is written in JSON syntax, which is valid YAML 1.2, so it can be read without a YAML library. The envelope flag ok is typed boolean without a literal value because the APIMatic TypeScript generator (CLI 2.0.0-beta.6, codegen v4) turns a boolean enum or const into the string "True" or "False".
